members.essay: Founder and President of Pioneers of Africa's Future (POAF). Initiated this movement in 2024 to build sustainable solutions, empower active students, and transform our continental future across all 54 African nations.

Led and organized a school music club, guiding members to two championship titles.
Mentored 183+ students through school and church music programs. Trained students weekly throughout the academic year, helping more than 14 students become school and church worship leaders. Four former students advanced to teaching roles and now train others.
Reached 600+ learners through live online classes delivered via Google Meet.
Provided 163 hours of private guitar instruction to students through one-on-one home-based lessons.
Earned 65,000 ETB through music teaching, mentorship, prizes, competitions, and awards.
